.pos { color: var(--teal);  }
.neg { color: var(--mag);  }

.table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.table th {
  text-align: left; color: var(--cyan); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 8px 6px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.table td { padding: 11px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); vertical-align: top; }
.table tr:hover td { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 5%, transparent); }

.tag {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--dim);
  letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
}
.tag.auto { color: var(--teal); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal) 40%, var(--line)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal) 14%, var(--panel)); box-shadow: 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal) 25%, transparent); }
.tag.hold { color: var(--amber); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 40%, var(--line)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 14%, var(--panel)); box-shadow: 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 25%, transparent); }
.tag.never { color: var(--mag); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mag) 40%, var(--line)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mag) 14%, var(--panel)); box-shadow: var(--glow-m); }
.tag.ice { color: var(--cyan); border-color: var(--line); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 12%, var(--panel)); }

.row {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: start;
  padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--panel-2);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.row:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.rail-card { border-left: 3px solid var(--amber); }
.rail-card.crit { border-left-color: var(--mag); box-shadow: inset 4px 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--mag) 15%, transparent); }
.rail-card.ok { border-left-color: var(--teal); }

.split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr; min-height: calc(100vh - var(--bar-h)); }
.pane { background: var(--rail); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); overflow: auto; }
.filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.filter {
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--dim);
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; cursor: pointer; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px;
}
.filter.on { color: var(--on-accent); border-color: var(--cyan); background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.mail { padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); cursor: pointer; }
.mail:hover, .mail.on { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 7%, transparent); }
.mail .from { font-weight: 650; color: var(--gold-2); }
.mail .sub { color: var(--text); }
.mail .meta { color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 4px; }
.read { padding: 22px 28px 48px; max-width: 860px; }
.read h2 { font-size: 22px; margin: 4px 0 8px; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--text); }
.letter {
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r);
  padding: 18px; color: var(--text); white-space: pre-wrap;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 5%, transparent);
}
textarea.letter { width: 100%; min-height: 160px; resize: vertical; }

.cal { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap: 8px; }
.day {
  min-height: 110px; background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px;
}
.day em { display: block; font-style: normal; color: var(--cyan); font-size: 11px; margin-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.post { background: var(--rail); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line); }

.matrix { width: 100%; }
.matrix td:nth-child(1) { width: 42%; }
.actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 12px; }

.login {
  min-height: 100vh; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 24px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(700px 380px at 20% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 18%, transparent), transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(600px 400px at 100% 100%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--mag) 16%, transparent), transparent 46%),
    var(--bg);
}
.login-card {
  width: 100%; max-width: 420px; background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 35%, transparent); border-radius: 18px; padding: 28px;
  box-shadow: var(--glow-c), var(--glow-m);
}
.login-card h1 { margin: 8px 0 4px; font-size: 22px; }
.field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin: 12px 0; color: var(--dim); }
.field input {
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px;
}
.field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.login-card .btn.primary { width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; padding: 11px; }
.hint { color: var(--faint); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 14px; }

.ticker {
  overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--rail);
  color: var(--lime);
  font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 6px 0;
  
}
.ticker span { display: inline-block; padding-left: 100%; animation: marquee 28s linear infinite; }
@keyframes marquee { to { transform: translateX(-100%); } }
.flow {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  padding: 10px 22px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--rail);
}
.flow a, .flow span.step {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 5px 11px; color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em;
}
.flow a.on, .flow span.step.on {
  color: var(--on-accent); border-color: var(--cyan); background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c);
}
.flow a.done, .flow span.step.done { color: var(--teal); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal) 40%, var(--line)); }
.flow .n {
  width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-grid; place-items: center;
  background: var(--panel-2); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;
}
.flow a.on .n { background: var(--on-accent); color: var(--cyan); }
.arrow { color: var(--faint); padding: 0 2px; }

.tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin: 0 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.tab {
  background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  color: var(--dim); padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; font-size: 11px;
}
.tab.on { color: var(--cyan); border-bottom-color: var(--cyan);  }

.split3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 300px 1fr 280px; min-height: calc(100vh - var(--bar-h) - 46px); }
.side-help { background: var(--rail); border-left: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 16px; overflow: auto; }
.side-help h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--cyan); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

.toolbar { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.mini { font-size: 12px; color: var(--dim); }
.progress {
  height: 6px; background: var(--panel-2); border-radius: 99px; overflow: hidden; margin: 8px 0 0;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 15%, transparent);
}
.progress > i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--cyan); }

.brain-stage {
  position: relative;
  height: calc(100vh - var(--bar-h) - 46px);
  background:
    radial-gradient(700px 420px at 50% 48%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 12%, transparent), transparent 42%),
    radial-gradient(500px 300px at 70% 30%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--mag) 10%, transparent), transparent 40%),
    var(--bg);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.brain-stage canvas { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
#hud { pointer-events: none; }
.brain-dock {
  position: absolute; right: 16px; top: 16px; width: min(300px, 90%);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 90%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 35%, transparent);
  border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px; backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  box-shadow: var(--glow-c);
}
.brain-dock h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cyan); }
.brain-tools { position: absolute; left: 16px; bottom: 16px; display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
#atom-stats { position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 16px; color: var(--cyan); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-shadow: none; }

#eco-hud { pointer-events: none; }
#eco-stats {
  position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 16px; z-index: 2;
  color: var(--cyan); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
  text-shadow: none; max-width: 62%;
}
.eco-log {
  position: absolute; left: 16px; bottom: 62px; width: min(420px, 70%);
  max-height: 168px; overflow: hidden; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none;
  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
  font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.45;
  mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, #000 18%);
}
.eco-l { padding: 1px 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.eco-in { color: var(--cyan); }
.eco-ok { color: var(--teal); }
.eco-hold { color: var(--mag); text-shadow: var(--glow-m); }
.eco-sys { color: var(--dim); }

.gauges { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 12px; }
.gauge {
  text-align: center;
}
.gauge canvas { width: 140px; height: 140px; display: block; margin: 0 auto; }
.gauge .v { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 6px; }
.gauge .l { color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.status-pill {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel);
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim);
  letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
}
.status-pill .dot.live { background: var(--teal); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--teal); }
.status-pill .dot.poll { background: var(--amber); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--amber); }
.status-pill .dot.off { background: var(--crimson); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--crimson); }

.chart { width: 100%; min-height: 200px; }
.chart svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
.legend { display: flex; gap: 14px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); margin-top: 8px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.legend i { display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 6px; vertical-align: middle; }
.bar-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 8px 0; font-size: 12px; }
.bar-row .lbl { flex: 0 0 120px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--dim); }
.bar-row .bar {
  height: 10px; border-radius: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan), var(--mag));
  min-width: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 35%, transparent);
}

.chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.chip-btn {
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--dim);
  border-radius: 99px; padding: 6px 14px; cursor: pointer;
  letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px;
}
.chip-btn.on, .chip-btn:hover { border-color: var(--cyan); color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.market-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
.m-card {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
}
.m-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.m-thumb {
  height: 120px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  background: radial-gradient(120px 80px at 50% 40%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 18%, transparent), var(--panel-2));
  font-size: 42px; position: relative;
}
.m-badge {
  position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 10px;
  background: var(--cyan); color: var(--on-accent); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800;
  border-radius: 99px; padding: 3px 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
}
.m-body { padding: 12px 14px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; flex: 1; }
.m-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; }
.m-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; margin-top: auto; }
.m-price { color: var(--teal); font-weight: 800;  }
.modal-wrap {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 72%, transparent);
  display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 40; padding: 16px;
}
.modal-wrap.open { display: flex; }
.modal {
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 40%, transparent);
  border-radius: 18px; max-width: 520px; width: 100%; max-height: 88vh; overflow: auto;
  padding: 24px; box-shadow: var(--glow-c);
}
.modal h2 { text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-size: 20px; color: var(--text); }
.toast {
  position: fixed; bottom: 20px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text);
  padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 12px; z-index: 50;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .3s;
}
.toast.show { opacity: 1; }

.glass-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
.glass {
  position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
  padding: 16px 18px; border-radius: 18px;
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.glass:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 45%, transparent);
  box-shadow: var(--glow-c);
}
.glass .ic {
  flex: 0 0 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 14px;
  display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 20%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--mag) 16%, transparent));
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.glass .t { font-weight: 800; }
.glass .d { color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; }
.glass .go { margin-left: auto; color: var(--cyan); }

.menu-btn { display: none; }

#netBanner {
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 80;
  display: none; text-align: center;
  background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--text);
  font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 8px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mag);
  box-shadow: var(--glow-m);
}
#netBanner.show { display: block; }
.nav a { position: relative; }
.nav-badge {
  position: absolute; top: 4px; right: 8px;
  background: var(--mag); color: #fff;
  font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; min-width: 16px; height: 16px;
  border-radius: 99px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 0 4px; box-shadow: var(--glow-m);
}
.pal-ovl {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 72%, transparent);
  display: none; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center;
  z-index: 90; padding-top: 12vh;
}
.pal-ovl.open { display: flex; }
.pal-box {
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 40%, transparent);
  border-radius: 16px; width: min(560px, 92vw);
  box-shadow: var(--glow-c); overflow: hidden;
}
#palInput {
  width: 100%; background: var(--bg); border: 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding: 15px 18px; color: var(--text); outline: none;
}
#palInput:focus { box-shadow: inset 0 0 18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 8%, transparent); }
#palList { max-height: 46vh; overflow: auto; padding: 6px; }
.pal-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px;
  padding: 10px 13px; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13.5px;
}
.pal-item.sel, .pal-item:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 14%, transparent), transparent);
  color: var(--cyan);
}
.pi-ic { width: 22px; text-align: center; flex: none; color: var(--cyan); }
.pi-t { font-weight: 700; }
.pi-h { margin-inline-start: auto; color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.pal-none { color: var(--dim); text-align: center; padding: 22px; font-size: 12.5px; }
kbd.kk {
  background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom-width: 2px;
  border-radius: 6px; padding: 1px 7px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--cyan);
  font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace;
}
/* ---------- Theme switcher ---------- */
.theme-switch { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel); }
.theme-switch button {
  border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--dim); cursor: pointer;
  width: 30px; height: 26px; border-radius: 999px; display: grid; place-items: center;
}
.theme-switch button svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.theme-switch button.on { background: var(--cyan); color: var(--on-accent); }
.theme-switch button:hover:not(.on) { color: var(--text); }

/* ---------- Soul page ---------- */
.soul-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr .9fr; gap: 14px; align-items: start; }
.soul-hero { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.soul-hero img { width: 84px; height: 84px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.soul-hero h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 18px; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--text); }
.field-block { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.field-block label { color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.field-block input, .field-block textarea {
  width: 100%; background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px 12px; color: var(--text); font: inherit; resize: vertical;
}
.field-block textarea { min-height: 84px; }
.field-block input:focus, .field-block textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.field-block .help { color: var(--faint); font-size: 11.5px; }
.login-art { display: block; width: 96px; height: 96px; margin: 0 auto 14px; border-radius: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.login-links { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin-top: 14px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--dim); }
.login-links a { color: var(--cyan); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
}

@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  .app { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .menu-btn { display: inline-flex; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; }
  .rail {
    display: none; position: fixed; z-index: 30; inset: 0 auto 0 0;
    width: min(300px, 88vw); height: 100%; overflow: auto;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 100vmax color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 60%, transparent);
  }
  .rail.open { display: flex; }
  .g4, .g3, .g2, .g21, .split, .split3, .gauges, .soul-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .search { display: none; }
  .ticker { display: none; }
  .split, .split3 { min-height: 0; }
  .pane { border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); max-height: 40vh; }
  .side-help { border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  :root { --bar-h: 54px; }
  .bar { padding: 0 12px; gap: 8px; }
  .bar h1 { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .08em; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; min-width: 0; }
  .bar-right { gap: 6px; }
  .bar-right .chip { display: none; }
  .bar-right .btn.ghost[data-logout] { padding: 0 10px; font-size: 10.5px; }
  .theme-switch button { width: 26px; height: 24px; }
  .bar h1 { flex: 1; }
  .page { padding: 14px; }
  .flow { padding: 8px 12px; overflow-x: auto; flex-wrap: nowrap; }
  .flow a, .flow span.step { flex: none; }
  .btn, .chip-btn, .filter { min-height: 40px; }
  .nav a { min-height: 44px; }
  .brain-stage { height: calc(100svh - var(--bar-h)); }
  .brain-dock { right: 8px; top: 8px; width: min(260px, 80%); }
  .cal { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .kpi .n { font-size: 26px; }
  .read { padding: 16px; }
  .table { display: block; overflow-x: auto; }
}

/* =====================================================================
   1.4.0 — Desk visual system. Monospace panels ("// TITLE" + hint),
   header metrics, status LEDs, severity bars, ledger rows, sparkline.
   Works with all four themes through the semantic tokens above.
   ===================================================================== */
body { font-family: ui-monospace, "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 13px; }
.desk-head {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 4px 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.desk-head .label { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .24em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cyan); }
.desk-head .title { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.01em; margin-top: 2px; }
.desk-head .sub { color: var(--dim); font-size: 11.5px; margin-top: 4px; }
.h-metrics { display: flex; gap: 22px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; }
.metric .k { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--faint); }
.metric .v { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.1; }
.metric .v.warn { color: var(--amber); }
.metric .v.good { color: var(--teal); }
.metric .v.bad { color: var(--mag); }
.clock { color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.blink { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--teal); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--teal); animation: blink 1.6s infinite; }
.blink.off { background: var(--mag); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--mag); animation: none; }
@keyframes blink { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: .25; } }

.panel { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.panel + .panel { margin-top: 14px; }
.panel-head {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 9px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel-2) 60%, transparent);
}
.panel-head .ph { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cyan); font-weight: 700; }
.panel-head .ph::before { content: "// "; color: var(--faint); }
.panel-head .hint { font-size: 11px; color: var(--faint); text-align: right; }
.panel-body { padding: 8px 14px 14px; }
.desk-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr .9fr; gap: 14px; align-items: start; }
.stack > .panel + .panel { margin-top: 14px; }

.event-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4px 1fr auto; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.event-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.sev { border-radius: 2px; background: var(--faint); min-height: 100%; }
.sev.high { background: var(--mag); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--mag); }
.sev.warn { background: var(--amber); }
.sev.info { background: var(--cyan); }
.ev-who { font-weight: 700; }
.ev-who .ref { color: var(--amber); font-weight: 600; margin-left: 6px; }
.ev-what { color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 2px; }
.ev-meta { color: var(--faint); font-size: 10.5px; margin-top: 4px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.ev-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; }
.event-row[data-decided] { opacity: .45; }

.led-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line); font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; }
.led-row:hover .l1 { color: var(--cyan); }
.led-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.led-row .l1 { font-weight: 650; }
.led-row .l2 { color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; max-width: 520px; }
.led-row .r { color: var(--faint); font-size: 10.5px; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.sys-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 12px; }
.sys-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.sys-mode { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--dim); }
.sys-mode.up { color: var(--teal); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal) 40%, var(--line)); }
.sys-mode.down { color: var(--mag); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mag) 40%, var(--line)); }
.spark { width: 100%; height: 64px; display: block; }
.empty { color: var(--faint); padding: 18px 0; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; }
.log-line { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--dim); padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line); }
.log-line b { color: var(--text); }

.drawer {
  position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: min(580px, 100%);
  background: var(--rail); border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
  transform: translateX(100%); transition: transform .2s ease; z-index: 40; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  box-shadow: -20px 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
}
.drawer.open { transform: none; }
.drawer-head { padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.drawer-head .ph { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cyan); font-weight: 700; }
.drawer-body { padding: 12px 16px; overflow: auto; flex: 1; }
.turn { margin: 0 0 10px; max-width: 92%; }
.turn .who { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--faint); margin-bottom: 2px; }
.turn .txt { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; white-space: pre-wrap; font-size: 12.5px; }
.turn.agent { margin-left: auto; }
.turn.agent .txt { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 35%, var(--line)); }
.turn.system .txt { color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; }

.form-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(210px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.fld { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); }
.fld input, .fld select, .fld textarea {
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; color: var(--text); font: inherit; min-width: 0;
}
.fld input:focus, .fld select:focus, .fld textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.fld textarea { min-height: 70px; resize: vertical; }
.fld .help { color: var(--faint); font-size: 10.5px; }
.fld.wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.switch { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line); font-size: 12px; }
.switch:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.switch .help { color: var(--faint); font-size: 10.5px; margin-top: 2px; }
.switch input[type="checkbox"] { width: 18px; height: 18px; accent-color: var(--cyan); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.thumb { width: 46px; height: 32px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel-2); display: block; }
.cat-table td, .cat-table th { font-size: 12px; }
.cat-table tr.on td { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 9%, transparent); }
.chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.chips .chip { text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.chips .chip b { color: var(--cyan); }
.save-bar { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin-top: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.save-bar .mini { flex: 1; }
.desk-cta {
  position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 16px; z-index: 5;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 92%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 45%, var(--line));
  border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; max-width: 320px; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); box-shadow: var(--glow-c);
}
.desk-cta .ph { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cyan); }
.desk-cta .big { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; margin: 4px 0 6px; }
.desk-cta p { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--dim); font-size: 11.5px; }
details.nav-more > summary { list-style: none; cursor: pointer; margin: 14px 12px 6px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; }
details.nav-more > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
details.nav-more > summary::after { content: " ▸"; }
details.nav-more[open] > summary::after { content: " ▾"; }
details.deploy > summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; padding: 8px 0; }
@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  .desk-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .desk-head .title { font-size: 18px; }
  .h-metrics { gap: 14px; }
  .metric .v { font-size: 18px; }
  .led-row .l2 { max-width: 60vw; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .event-row { grid-template-columns: 4px 1fr; }
  .ev-actions { grid-column: 2; justify-content: flex-start; }
  .desk-cta { left: 10px; right: 10px; top: 10px; max-width: none; }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1.5.0 — 3D background (admin only), simulator, database
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
#bg3d { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: 1; transition: opacity .6s ease; }
#bg3d canvas { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
#bg3d.off { opacity: 0; }
.app, .login, .pal-ovl, .toast, #netBanner, .db-modal { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.rail { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rail) 82%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); }
.stage .bar { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 70%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }
.panel, .card, .desk-cta, .login-card { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 88%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); }
html[data-theme="light"] .panel, html[data-theme="light"] .card, html[data-theme="light"] .login-card { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 92%, transparent); }
.ticker { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel-2) 80%, transparent); }

/* simulator */
.sim-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(320px, 520px) 1fr; gap: 14px; align-items: start; }
.sim-phone { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 640px; }
.sim-screen { position: relative; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background:
  radial-gradient(600px 300px at 20% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 8%, transparent), transparent 60%), var(--bg); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.sim-screen.over .sim-dropzone { opacity: 1; transform: none; border-color: var(--cyan); color: var(--cyan); }
.sim-log { flex: 1; min-height: 420px; max-height: 60vh; overflow-y: auto; padding: 14px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.sim-msg { max-width: 86%; padding: 8px 11px 6px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; position: relative; }
.sim-msg .sim-meta { font-size: 10px; color: var(--faint); text-align: right; margin-top: 3px; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.sim-msg.me { align-self: flex-end; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal) 22%, var(--panel)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal) 40%, var(--line)); border-bottom-right-radius: 3px; }
.sim-msg.bot { align-self: flex-start; background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom-left-radius: 3px; }
.sim-msg.sys { align-self: center; background: transparent; color: var(--dim); font-size: 11.5px; border: 1px dashed var(--line); max-width: 96%; text-align: center; }
.sim-msg.typing .sim-body span { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); margin-right: 4px; animation: simblink 1.2s infinite; }
.sim-msg.typing .sim-body span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .2s; } .sim-msg.typing .sim-body span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .4s; }
@keyframes simblink { 0%, 80%, 100% { opacity: .2; } 40% { opacity: 1; } }
.sim-dropzone { margin: 0 12px 10px; padding: 10px; border: 1.5px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--dim) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11.5px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: all .2s ease; }
.sim-dropzone:hover { border-color: var(--cyan); color: var(--cyan); }
.sim-quick { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 12px 0; }
.sim-quick button { background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--dim); border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 11px; font-size: 11.5px; cursor: pointer; }
.sim-quick button:hover { color: var(--cyan); border-color: var(--cyan); }
.sim-input { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; align-items: center; }
.sim-input input[type="text"], .sim-input #sim-text { flex: 1; background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 14px; color: var(--text); }
.sim-input #sim-text:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.sim-attach { border-radius: 50%; width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; }
.sim-select { background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 10px; font-size: 12px; }
.sim-file { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: start; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line); }
.sim-file:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.sim-file-ic { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.2; text-align: center; }
.sim-file-main { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; font-size: 12px; }
.sim-file-main b { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.sim-file-main span { color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px; }
.sim-file-main em { color: var(--faint); font-style: normal; font-size: 11px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.sim-file-main em.warn { color: var(--amber); }
.sim-file-del { padding: 4px 8px; }
.sim-note { color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }
.sim-note code { background: var(--panel-2); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px; }

/* database */
.db-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr; gap: 14px; align-items: start; }
.db-group { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--faint); margin: 12px 0 4px; }
.db-group:first-child { margin-top: 4px; }
.db-tab { width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 9px; color: var(--dim); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-size: 12.5px; }
.db-tab b { color: var(--faint); font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.db-tab:hover, .db-tab.on { background: var(--panel-2); border-color: var(--line); color: var(--text); }
.db-tab.on { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 50%, var(--line)); color: var(--cyan); }
.db-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin: 4px 0 10px; }
.db-toolbar input { flex: 1; min-width: 180px; background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; color: var(--text); }
.db-toolbar input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.db-toolbar label.btn { cursor: pointer; }
.db-wrap { overflow: auto; max-height: 62vh; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; }
.db-rows th { position: sticky; top: 0; background: var(--panel-2); z-index: 1; white-space: nowrap; }
.db-rows td { font-size: 12px; max-width: 260px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.db-rows td.db-act { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.db-pager { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 10px; }
.db-modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 60; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 70%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px; }
.db-modal[hidden] { display: none; }
.db-modal-box { width: min(760px, 100%); max-height: 92vh; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
.db-modal-box .panel-head { flex: none; }
.db-modal-body { overflow: auto; padding: 12px 16px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px 14px; }
.db-modal-box .save-bar { padding: 10px 16px 14px; margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.db-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-size: 12px; }
.db-field span { color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.db-field span em { color: var(--faint); font-style: normal; }
.db-field input, .db-field textarea, .db-field select { background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; color: var(--text); width: 100%; }
.db-field textarea { min-height: 84px; grid-column: 1 / -1; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; }
.db-field:has(textarea) { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.db-field.ro input, .db-field.ro textarea { opacity: .6; }
.db-field input:focus, .db-field textarea:focus, .db-field select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }

@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  .sim-grid, .db-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .db-modal-body { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .sim-phone { min-height: 520px; }
  .sim-log { max-height: 52vh; min-height: 320px; }
  .sim-msg { max-width: 92%; }
  #bg3d { opacity: .7; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #bg3d { opacity: .6; } }

</style>

.pane { background: var(--rail); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); overflow: auto; }
.filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.filter {
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--dim);
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; cursor: pointer; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px;
}
.filter.on { color: var(--on-accent); border-color: var(--cyan); background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.mail { padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); cursor: pointer; }
.mail:hover, .mail.on { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 7%, transparent); }
.mail .from { font-weight: 650; color: var(--gold-2); }
.mail .sub { color: var(--text); }
.mail .meta { color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 4px; }
.read { padding: 22px 28px 48px; max-width: 860px; }
.read h2 { font-size: 22px; margin: 4px 0 8px; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--text); }
.letter {
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r);
  padding: 18px; color: var(--text); white-space: pre-wrap;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 5%, transparent);
}
textarea.letter { width: 100%; min-height: 160px; resize: vertical; }

.cal { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap: 8px; }
.day {
  min-height: 110px; background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px;
}
.day em { display: block; font-style: normal; color: var(--cyan); font-size: 11px; margin-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.post { background: var(--rail); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line); }

.matrix { width: 100%; }
.matrix td:nth-child(1) { width: 42%; }
.actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 12px; }

.login {
  min-height: 100vh; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 24px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(700px 380px at 20% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 18%, transparent), transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(600px 400px at 100% 100%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--mag) 16%, transparent), transparent 46%),
    var(--bg);
}
.login-card {
  width: 100%; max-width: 420px; background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 35%, transparent); border-radius: 18px; padding: 28px;
  box-shadow: var(--glow-c), var(--glow-m);
}
.login-card h1 { margin: 8px 0 4px; font-size: 22px; }
.field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin: 12px 0; color: var(--dim); }
.field input {
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px;
}
.field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.login-card .btn.primary { width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; padding: 11px; }
.hint { color: var(--faint); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 14px; }

.ticker {
  overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--rail);
  color: var(--lime);
  font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 6px 0;
  
}
.ticker span { display: inline-block; padding-left: 100%; animation: marquee 28s linear infinite; }
@keyframes marquee { to { transform: translateX(-100%); } }
.flow {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  padding: 10px 22px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--rail);
}
.flow a, .flow span.step {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 5px 11px; color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em;
}
.flow a.on, .flow span.step.on {
  color: var(--on-accent); border-color: var(--cyan); background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c);
}
.flow a.done, .flow span.step.done { color: var(--teal); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal) 40%, var(--line)); }
.flow .n {
  width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-grid; place-items: center;
  background: var(--panel-2); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;
}
.flow a.on .n { background: var(--on-accent); color: var(--cyan); }
.arrow { color: var(--faint); padding: 0 2px; }

.tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin: 0 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.tab {
  background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  color: var(--dim); padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; font-size: 11px;
}
.tab.on { color: var(--cyan); border-bottom-color: var(--cyan);  }

.split3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 300px 1fr 280px; min-height: calc(100vh - var(--bar-h) - 46px); }
.side-help { background: var(--rail); border-left: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 16px; overflow: auto; }
.side-help h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--cyan); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

.toolbar { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.mini { font-size: 12px; color: var(--dim); }
.progress {
  height: 6px; background: var(--panel-2); border-radius: 99px; overflow: hidden; margin: 8px 0 0;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 15%, transparent);
}
.progress > i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--cyan); }

.brain-stage {
  position: relative;
  height: calc(100vh - var(--bar-h) - 46px);
  background:
    radial-gradient(700px 420px at 50% 48%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 12%, transparent), transparent 42%),
    radial-gradient(500px 300px at 70% 30%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--mag) 10%, transparent), transparent 40%),
    var(--bg);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.brain-stage canvas { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
#hud { pointer-events: none; }
.brain-dock {
  position: absolute; right: 16px; top: 16px; width: min(300px, 90%);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 90%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 35%, transparent);
  border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px; backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  box-shadow: var(--glow-c);
}
.brain-dock h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cyan); }
.brain-tools { position: absolute; left: 16px; bottom: 16px; display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
#atom-stats { position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 16px; color: var(--cyan); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-shadow: none; }

#eco-hud { pointer-events: none; }
#eco-stats {
  position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 16px; z-index: 2;
  color: var(--cyan); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
  text-shadow: none; max-width: 62%;
}
.eco-log {
  position: absolute; left: 16px; bottom: 62px; width: min(420px, 70%);
  max-height: 168px; overflow: hidden; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none;
  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
  font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.45;
  mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, #000 18%);
}
.eco-l { padding: 1px 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.eco-in { color: var(--cyan); }
.eco-ok { color: var(--teal); }
.eco-hold { color: var(--mag); text-shadow: var(--glow-m); }
.eco-sys { color: var(--dim); }

.gauges { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 12px; }
.gauge {
  text-align: center;
}
.gauge canvas { width: 140px; height: 140px; display: block; margin: 0 auto; }
.gauge .v { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 6px; }
.gauge .l { color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.status-pill {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel);
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim);
  letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
}
.status-pill .dot.live { background: var(--teal); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--teal); }
.status-pill .dot.poll { background: var(--amber); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--amber); }
.status-pill .dot.off { background: var(--crimson); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--crimson); }

.chart { width: 100%; min-height: 200px; }
.chart svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
.legend { display: flex; gap: 14px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); margin-top: 8px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.legend i { display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 6px; vertical-align: middle; }
.bar-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 8px 0; font-size: 12px; }
.bar-row .lbl { flex: 0 0 120px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--dim); }
.bar-row .bar {
  height: 10px; border-radius: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan), var(--mag));
  min-width: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 35%, transparent);
}

.chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.chip-btn {
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--dim);
  border-radius: 99px; padding: 6px 14px; cursor: pointer;
  letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px;
}
.chip-btn.on, .chip-btn:hover { border-color: var(--cyan); color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.market-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
.m-card {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
}
.m-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.m-thumb {
  height: 120px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  background: radial-gradient(120px 80px at 50% 40%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 18%, transparent), var(--panel-2));
  font-size: 42px; position: relative;
}
.m-badge {
  position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 10px;
  background: var(--cyan); color: var(--on-accent); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800;
  border-radius: 99px; padding: 3px 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
}
.m-body { padding: 12px 14px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; flex: 1; }
.m-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; }
.m-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; margin-top: auto; }
.m-price { color: var(--teal); font-weight: 800;  }
.modal-wrap {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 72%, transparent);
  display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 40; padding: 16px;
}
.modal-wrap.open { display: flex; }
.modal {
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 40%, transparent);
  border-radius: 18px; max-width: 520px; width: 100%; max-height: 88vh; overflow: auto;
  padding: 24px; box-shadow: var(--glow-c);
}
.modal h2 { text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-size: 20px; color: var(--text); }
.toast {
  position: fixed; bottom: 20px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text);
  padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 12px; z-index: 50;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .3s;
}
.toast.show { opacity: 1; }

.glass-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
.glass {
  position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
  padding: 16px 18px; border-radius: 18px;
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.glass:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 45%, transparent);
  box-shadow: var(--glow-c);
}
.glass .ic {
  flex: 0 0 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 14px;
  display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 20%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--mag) 16%, transparent));
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.glass .t { font-weight: 800; }
.glass .d { color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; }
.glass .go { margin-left: auto; color: var(--cyan); }

.menu-btn { display: none; }

#netBanner {
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 80;
  display: none; text-align: center;
  background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--text);
  font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 8px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mag);
  box-shadow: var(--glow-m);
}
#netBanner.show { display: block; }
.nav a { position: relative; }
.nav-badge {
  position: absolute; top: 4px; right: 8px;
  background: var(--mag); color: #fff;
  font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; min-width: 16px; height: 16px;
  border-radius: 99px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 0 4px; box-shadow: var(--glow-m);
}
.pal-ovl {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 72%, transparent);
  display: none; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center;
  z-index: 90; padding-top: 12vh;
}
.pal-ovl.open { display: flex; }
.pal-box {
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 40%, transparent);
  border-radius: 16px; width: min(560px, 92vw);
  box-shadow: var(--glow-c); overflow: hidden;
}
#palInput {
  width: 100%; background: var(--bg); border: 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding: 15px 18px; color: var(--text); outline: none;
}
#palInput:focus { box-shadow: inset 0 0 18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 8%, transparent); }
#palList { max-height: 46vh; overflow: auto; padding: 6px; }
.pal-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px;
  padding: 10px 13px; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13.5px;
}
.pal-item.sel, .pal-item:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 14%, transparent), transparent);
  color: var(--cyan);
}
.pi-ic { width: 22px; text-align: center; flex: none; color: var(--cyan); }
.pi-t { font-weight: 700; }
.pi-h { margin-inline-start: auto; color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.pal-none { color: var(--dim); text-align: center; padding: 22px; font-size: 12.5px; }
kbd.kk {
  background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom-width: 2px;
  border-radius: 6px; padding: 1px 7px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--cyan);
  font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace;
}
/* ---------- Theme switcher ---------- */
.theme-switch { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel); }
.theme-switch button {
  border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--dim); cursor: pointer;
  width: 30px; height: 26px; border-radius: 999px; display: grid; place-items: center;
}
.theme-switch button svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.theme-switch button.on { background: var(--cyan); color: var(--on-accent); }
.theme-switch button:hover:not(.on) { color: var(--text); }

/* ---------- Soul page ---------- */
.soul-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr .9fr; gap: 14px; align-items: start; }
.soul-hero { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.soul-hero img { width: 84px; height: 84px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.soul-hero h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 18px; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--text); }
.field-block { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.field-block label { color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.field-block input, .field-block textarea {
  width: 100%; background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px 12px; color: var(--text); font: inherit; resize: vertical;
}
.field-block textarea { min-height: 84px; }
.field-block input:focus, .field-block textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.field-block .help { color: var(--faint); font-size: 11.5px; }
.login-art { display: block; width: 96px; height: 96px; margin: 0 auto 14px; border-radius: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.login-links { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin-top: 14px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--dim); }
.login-links a { color: var(--cyan); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
}

@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  .app { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .menu-btn { display: inline-flex; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; }
  .rail {
    display: none; position: fixed; z-index: 30; inset: 0 auto 0 0;
    width: min(300px, 88vw); height: 100%; overflow: auto;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 100vmax color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 60%, transparent);
  }
  .rail.open { display: flex; }
  .g4, .g3, .g2, .g21, .split, .split3, .gauges, .soul-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .search { display: none; }
  .ticker { display: none; }
  .split, .split3 { min-height: 0; }
  .pane { border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); max-height: 40vh; }
  .side-help { border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  :root { --bar-h: 54px; }
  .bar { padding: 0 12px; gap: 8px; }
  .bar h1 { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .08em; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; min-width: 0; }
  .bar-right { gap: 6px; }
  .bar-right .chip { display: none; }
  .bar-right .btn.ghost[data-logout] { padding: 0 10px; font-size: 10.5px; }
  .theme-switch button { width: 26px; height: 24px; }
  .bar h1 { flex: 1; }
  .page { padding: 14px; }
  .flow { padding: 8px 12px; overflow-x: auto; flex-wrap: nowrap; }
  .flow a, .flow span.step { flex: none; }
  .btn, .chip-btn, .filter { min-height: 40px; }
  .nav a { min-height: 44px; }
  .brain-stage { height: calc(100svh - var(--bar-h)); }
  .brain-dock { right: 8px; top: 8px; width: min(260px, 80%); }
  .cal { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .kpi .n { font-size: 26px; }
  .read { padding: 16px; }
  .table { display: block; overflow-x: auto; }
}

/* =====================================================================
   1.4.0 — Desk visual system. Monospace panels ("// TITLE" + hint),
   header metrics, status LEDs, severity bars, ledger rows, sparkline.
   Works with all four themes through the semantic tokens above.
   ===================================================================== */
body { font-family: ui-monospace, "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 13px; }
.desk-head {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 4px 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.desk-head .label { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .24em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cyan); }
.desk-head .title { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.01em; margin-top: 2px; }
.desk-head .sub { color: var(--dim); font-size: 11.5px; margin-top: 4px; }
.h-metrics { display: flex; gap: 22px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; }
.metric .k { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--faint); }
.metric .v { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.1; }
.metric .v.warn { color: var(--amber); }
.metric .v.good { color: var(--teal); }
.metric .v.bad { color: var(--mag); }
.clock { color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.blink { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--teal); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--teal); animation: blink 1.6s infinite; }
.blink.off { background: var(--mag); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--mag); animation: none; }
@keyframes blink { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: .25; } }

.panel { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.panel + .panel { margin-top: 14px; }
.panel-head {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 9px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel-2) 60%, transparent);
}
.panel-head .ph { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cyan); font-weight: 700; }
.panel-head .ph::before { content: "// "; color: var(--faint); }
.panel-head .hint { font-size: 11px; color: var(--faint); text-align: right; }
.panel-body { padding: 8px 14px 14px; }
.desk-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr .9fr; gap: 14px; align-items: start; }
.stack > .panel + .panel { margin-top: 14px; }

.event-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4px 1fr auto; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.event-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.sev { border-radius: 2px; background: var(--faint); min-height: 100%; }
.sev.high { background: var(--mag); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--mag); }
.sev.warn { background: var(--amber); }
.sev.info { background: var(--cyan); }
.ev-who { font-weight: 700; }
.ev-who .ref { color: var(--amber); font-weight: 600; margin-left: 6px; }
.ev-what { color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 2px; }
.ev-meta { color: var(--faint); font-size: 10.5px; margin-top: 4px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.ev-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; }
.event-row[data-decided] { opacity: .45; }

.led-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line); font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; }
.led-row:hover .l1 { color: var(--cyan); }
.led-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.led-row .l1 { font-weight: 650; }
.led-row .l2 { color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; max-width: 520px; }
.led-row .r { color: var(--faint); font-size: 10.5px; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.sys-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 12px; }
.sys-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.sys-mode { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--dim); }
.sys-mode.up { color: var(--teal); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal) 40%, var(--line)); }
.sys-mode.down { color: var(--mag); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mag) 40%, var(--line)); }
.spark { width: 100%; height: 64px; display: block; }
.empty { color: var(--faint); padding: 18px 0; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; }
.log-line { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--dim); padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line); }
.log-line b { color: var(--text); }

.drawer {
  position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: min(580px, 100%);
  background: var(--rail); border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
  transform: translateX(100%); transition: transform .2s ease; z-index: 40; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  box-shadow: -20px 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
}
.drawer.open { transform: none; }
.drawer-head { padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.drawer-head .ph { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cyan); font-weight: 700; }
.drawer-body { padding: 12px 16px; overflow: auto; flex: 1; }
.turn { margin: 0 0 10px; max-width: 92%; }
.turn .who { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--faint); margin-bottom: 2px; }
.turn .txt { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; white-space: pre-wrap; font-size: 12.5px; }
.turn.agent { margin-left: auto; }
.turn.agent .txt { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 35%, var(--line)); }
.turn.system .txt { color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; }

.form-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(210px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.fld { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); }
.fld input, .fld select, .fld textarea {
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; color: var(--text); font: inherit; min-width: 0;
}
.fld input:focus, .fld select:focus, .fld textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.fld textarea { min-height: 70px; resize: vertical; }
.fld .help { color: var(--faint); font-size: 10.5px; }
.fld.wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.switch { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line); font-size: 12px; }
.switch:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.switch .help { color: var(--faint); font-size: 10.5px; margin-top: 2px; }
.switch input[type="checkbox"] { width: 18px; height: 18px; accent-color: var(--cyan); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.thumb { width: 46px; height: 32px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel-2); display: block; }
.cat-table td, .cat-table th { font-size: 12px; }
.cat-table tr.on td { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 9%, transparent); }
.chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.chips .chip { text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.chips .chip b { color: var(--cyan); }
.save-bar { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin-top: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.save-bar .mini { flex: 1; }
.desk-cta {
  position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 16px; z-index: 5;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 92%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 45%, var(--line));
  border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; max-width: 320px; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); box-shadow: var(--glow-c);
}
.desk-cta .ph { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cyan); }
.desk-cta .big { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; margin: 4px 0 6px; }
.desk-cta p { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--dim); font-size: 11.5px; }
details.nav-more > summary { list-style: none; cursor: pointer; margin: 14px 12px 6px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; }
details.nav-more > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
details.nav-more > summary::after { content: " ▸"; }
details.nav-more[open] > summary::after { content: " ▾"; }
details.deploy > summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; padding: 8px 0; }
@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  .desk-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .desk-head .title { font-size: 18px; }
  .h-metrics { gap: 14px; }
  .metric .v { font-size: 18px; }
  .led-row .l2 { max-width: 60vw; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .event-row { grid-template-columns: 4px 1fr; }
  .ev-actions { grid-column: 2; justify-content: flex-start; }
  .desk-cta { left: 10px; right: 10px; top: 10px; max-width: none; }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1.5.0 — 3D background (admin only), simulator, database
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
#bg3d { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: 1; transition: opacity .6s ease; }
#bg3d canvas { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
#bg3d.off { opacity: 0; }
.app, .login, .pal-ovl, .toast, #netBanner, .db-modal { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.rail { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rail) 82%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); }
.stage .bar { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 70%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }
.panel, .card, .desk-cta, .login-card { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 88%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); }
html[data-theme="light"] .panel, html[data-theme="light"] .card, html[data-theme="light"] .login-card { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 92%, transparent); }
.ticker { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel-2) 80%, transparent); }

/* simulator */
.sim-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(320px, 520px) 1fr; gap: 14px; align-items: start; }
.sim-phone { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 640px; }
.sim-screen { position: relative; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background:
  radial-gradient(600px 300px at 20% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 8%, transparent), transparent 60%), var(--bg); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.sim-screen.over .sim-dropzone { opacity: 1; transform: none; border-color: var(--cyan); color: var(--cyan); }
.sim-log { flex: 1; min-height: 420px; max-height: 60vh; overflow-y: auto; padding: 14px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.sim-msg { max-width: 86%; padding: 8px 11px 6px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; position: relative; }
.sim-msg .sim-meta { font-size: 10px; color: var(--faint); text-align: right; margin-top: 3px; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.sim-msg.me { align-self: flex-end; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal) 22%, var(--panel)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal) 40%, var(--line)); border-bottom-right-radius: 3px; }
.sim-msg.bot { align-self: flex-start; background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom-left-radius: 3px; }
.sim-msg.sys { align-self: center; background: transparent; color: var(--dim); font-size: 11.5px; border: 1px dashed var(--line); max-width: 96%; text-align: center; }
.sim-msg.typing .sim-body span { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); margin-right: 4px; animation: simblink 1.2s infinite; }
.sim-msg.typing .sim-body span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .2s; } .sim-msg.typing .sim-body span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .4s; }
@keyframes simblink { 0%, 80%, 100% { opacity: .2; } 40% { opacity: 1; } }
.sim-dropzone { margin: 0 12px 10px; padding: 10px; border: 1.5px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--dim) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11.5px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: all .2s ease; }
.sim-dropzone:hover { border-color: var(--cyan); color: var(--cyan); }
.sim-quick { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 12px 0; }
.sim-quick button { background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--dim); border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 11px; font-size: 11.5px; cursor: pointer; }
.sim-quick button:hover { color: var(--cyan); border-color: var(--cyan); }
.sim-input { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; align-items: center; }
.sim-input input[type="text"], .sim-input #sim-text { flex: 1; background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 14px; color: var(--text); }
.sim-input #sim-text:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.sim-attach { border-radius: 50%; width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; }
.sim-select { background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 10px; font-size: 12px; }
.sim-file { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: start; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line); }
.sim-file:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.sim-file-ic { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.2; text-align: center; }
.sim-file-main { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; font-size: 12px; }
.sim-file-main b { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.sim-file-main span { color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px; }
.sim-file-main em { color: var(--faint); font-style: normal; font-size: 11px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.sim-file-main em.warn { color: var(--amber); }
.sim-file-del { padding: 4px 8px; }
.sim-note { color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }
.sim-note code { background: var(--panel-2); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px; }

/* database */
.db-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr; gap: 14px; align-items: start; }
.db-group { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--faint); margin: 12px 0 4px; }
.db-group:first-child { margin-top: 4px; }
.db-tab { width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 9px; color: var(--dim); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-size: 12.5px; }
.db-tab b { color: var(--faint); font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.db-tab:hover, .db-tab.on { background: var(--panel-2); border-color: var(--line); color: var(--text); }
.db-tab.on { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 50%, var(--line)); color: var(--cyan); }
.db-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin: 4px 0 10px; }
.db-toolbar input { flex: 1; min-width: 180px; background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; color: var(--text); }
.db-toolbar input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }
.db-toolbar label.btn { cursor: pointer; }
.db-wrap { overflow: auto; max-height: 62vh; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; }
.db-rows th { position: sticky; top: 0; background: var(--panel-2); z-index: 1; white-space: nowrap; }
.db-rows td { font-size: 12px; max-width: 260px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.db-rows td.db-act { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.db-pager { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 10px; }
.db-modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 60; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 70%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px; }
.db-modal[hidden] { display: none; }
.db-modal-box { width: min(760px, 100%); max-height: 92vh; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
.db-modal-box .panel-head { flex: none; }
.db-modal-body { overflow: auto; padding: 12px 16px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px 14px; }
.db-modal-box .save-bar { padding: 10px 16px 14px; margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.db-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-size: 12px; }
.db-field span { color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.db-field span em { color: var(--faint); font-style: normal; }
.db-field input, .db-field textarea, .db-field select { background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; color: var(--text); width: 100%; }
.db-field textarea { min-height: 84px; grid-column: 1 / -1; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; }
.db-field:has(textarea) { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.db-field.ro input, .db-field.ro textarea { opacity: .6; }
.db-field input:focus, .db-field textarea:focus, .db-field select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--glow-c); }

@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  .sim-grid, .db-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .db-modal-body { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .sim-phone { min-height: 520px; }
  .sim-log { max-height: 52vh; min-height: 320px; }
  .sim-msg { max-width: 92%; }
  #bg3d { opacity: .7; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #bg3d { opacity: .6; } }

</style>
